findings.body:
`open(...).read()` does not explicitly close the file. While CPython often closes the file on garbage collection, it is not guaranteed and can cause a resource leak in long-running processes or tight loops. Use a `with` statement to guarantee cleanup:

```python
with open(ENTRYPOINT, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    source = f.read()
```
findings.suggestion:
with open(ENTRYPOINT, encoding="utf-8") as f:
    source = f.read()
findings.title: Use a context manager to close the entrypoint file

value.summary: The entrypoint file is not closed after reading; use a `with` statement to ensure the file descriptor is released.
